lead.headline: Trump greets Xi on the tarmac as U.S. and China extend trade truce
lead.dek: The Chinese leader's first state visit in 11 years brings a White House arrival ceremony and a state dinner Thursday
body: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland outside Washington on Wednesday evening for a three-day state visit, and President Donald Trump met him on the tarmac with a red carpet, a 21-member honor guard and a B-1 bomber flyover, ABC News and Al Jazeera reported.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two governments agreed Wednesday to extend the trade truce reached in Busan, which had been due to lapse Nov. 10, through Jan. 10. The extension keeps tariff cuts in place and holds off new trade restrictions while the leaders meet again in China in November and in Florida in December, ABC News reported.

Xi and Trump are scheduled for a White House arrival ceremony, a review of troops and a black-tie dinner with technology executives Thursday, with a National Archives tour Friday. Trade, artificial intelligence, the Iran war and Taiwan are on the agenda, and NPR reported the two sides are still negotiating an extension of a separate rare earths truce.

briefs.headline: Judge orders White House to restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
briefs.summary: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly granted a 14-day restraining order after midnight Thursday, finding the outlets likely lost their passes without due process.

briefs.headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.13%, highest since 2007, as oil tops $103
briefs.summary: Brent crude rose 3.8% Wednesday after Fed Governor Michael Barr said more rate hikes are likely needed; the Dow fell 352 points and the 30-year mortgage rate hit 7.26%.

briefs.headline: Missouri map fight reaches Supreme Court for a third time
briefs.summary: Opponents asked the justices late Tuesday to block the Trump-backed map again after the 8th Circuit revived it; absentee voting has begun under the 2022 districts.

briefs.headline: ICE officer who shot Austin driver was not wearing a body camera
briefs.summary: Two DHS officials told NBC News the officer had an issued camera but did not wear it; Wilber Garces Perez, 28, remains in ICE custody with a bullet near his spine as Travis County prosecutors investigate.

briefs.headline: Category 5 Polo spreads rain bands over southwest Mexico
briefs.summary: NHC Advisory 15 at 3 a.m. CST Thursday put winds at 160 mph about 150 miles off Zihuatanejo. The core is forecast to stay offshore; Guerrero could get up to 8 inches of rain.

briefs.headline: Israeli election panel bars both main Arab lists
briefs.summary: The Central Elections Committee voted Wednesday to disqualify Ra'am and the Joint List from the Oct. 27 vote. The Supreme Court, which has overturned such bans before, reviews them next week.

briefs.headline: Russian missiles and drones kill 16 across Ukraine
briefs.summary: Ukrainian officials said 282 drones and waves of ballistic missiles struck overnight, with eight dead in Donetsk Oblast, six in Kharkiv and two in Kyiv, where a maternity hospital was damaged.

briefs.headline: Monarchy-aligned PAM leads Morocco vote with 97 seats
briefs.summary: Interior Minister Abdelouafi Laftit said the party took 97 of 395 seats, ahead of Prime Minister Aziz Akhannouch's RNI at 66. Turnout fell to 38%, and PAM must find coalition partners.

briefs.headline: Morrisey declares flood emergency in Boone and Lincoln
briefs.summary: Slow-moving storms since Monday sent creeks over their banks, flooding roads and forcing water rescues in the two counties, the governor said in a declaration late Wednesday.

briefs.headline: PSC opens hearing on Hope Gas 4% leak-repair rate request
briefs.summary: Hope Gas wants to raise residential bills an average $4.37 a month to fund about $30M a year in pipe replacement; it told the PSC Wednesday it has found roughly 1,460 leaks on 1,650 miles of line.

briefs.headline: Justices weigh whether courts can hear Methodist property fight
briefs.summary: Thirty-three congregations that want to leave the United Methodist Church with their buildings argued Wednesday that a fraud claim belongs in court; Chief Justice Haley Bunn asked how that avoids the First Amendment.

briefs.headline: Harpers Ferry woman charged with murder, arson in 2025 fire
briefs.summary: State police arrested Nicole Ellen Taylor, 55, Tuesday after a yearlong investigation of the Sept. 30, 2025, house fire that killed her husband and daughter; her husband had been shot, troopers said.

regional.item: Chris Chiles, who spent three decades in the Cabell County prosecutor's office and nine years as a circuit judge, died this week.
A Clay County man faces three counts of malicious wounding after three people were stabbed on Dutch Ridge Road near Clendenin Wednesday.
A Toys R Us shop opens in October at Grand Central Mall in Vienna, next to Dunham's and Boot Barn, the retailer said Wednesday.
A superseding indictment charges a Pipestem man with 394 counts involving 59 women over 11 years, Prosecutor Chris Lefler said Wednesday.

away.item: A tanker of methyl methacrylate separated from its cab on Route 9 in Woodford Monday, closing the highway into Wednesday night.

hotspots.item: The Webster County Board of Education approved a girls' middle school softball program at its Sept. 14 meeting, the Webster Echo reported.
Surf City posted a request Sept. 23 for engineers to set up a solid waste enterprise fund and a five-year trash rate model; submittals are due Nov. 16.

briefs.headline: PG council defers Civic Core arena decision to Nov. 30
briefs.summary: Council voted this week to put off a choice between two downtown arena and theatre options until Nov. 30, past the Oct. 17 civic election. Four councillors opposed the delay.

briefs.headline: Prince George RCMP arrest 1 suspect in 4 store robberies
briefs.summary: Police said Wednesday they arrested one suspect Tuesday and searched a residence in the four armed robberies of vape and cannabis stores between Sept. 6 and 19. Other suspects are still sought.

briefs.headline: Rustad won't run as 4th NDP minister exits B.C. race
briefs.summary: The B.C. Conservatives said Wednesday former leader John Rustad, MLA for Nechako Lakes, will not seek re-election Oct. 24. Brenda Bailey became the fourth Eby cabinet minister to bow out.

briefs.headline: Multiple fires in Boston Bar draw investigators
briefs.summary: Structure fires broke out in the Fraser Canyon town early Tuesday and crews needed more than 10 hours to put them out, the Hope Fire Department said; the regional district gave no count and would not say whether arson is suspected.

briefs.headline: Quebec leaders spar on immigration in final debate
briefs.summary: Five party leaders met Wednesday night in Montreal for a two-hour French debate 11 days before the Oct. 5 vote, proposing annual immigration caps of 45,000 to 70,000 and trading positions on a referendum.

briefs.headline: Carney says he weighed risk of U.S. military action
briefs.summary: In a New York Times interview published Wednesday, the prime minister said he studied U.S.-led military action against Canada as an 'extreme tail risk,' not a base case, and said he still speaks with Trump often.

briefs.headline: Arctic sea ice ties 10th-lowest minimum in satellite record
briefs.summary: NASA and NSIDC said the ice reached 1.78 million square miles on Sept. 12, tied with 2008, 2010 and 2025. The 20 lowest minimums since 1978 are the last 20 years.

briefs.headline: Webb finds heavy elements leaking from galaxies at 500M years
briefs.summary: University of Arizona astronomers reported in Nature Astronomy that carbon, oxygen and silicon were escaping galaxies 500 million years after the Big Bang, earlier than models predicted.

briefs.headline: SpaceX stacks Starship for orbital flight, awaits FAA license
briefs.summary: Ship 41 was lifted onto Booster 21 at Starbase early Wednesday, completing the 407-foot stack. Flight 14 is targeted for 8:15 a.m. ET Monday, pending FAA approval, and would deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites.

briefs.headline: Longer REM sleep linked to lower risk of 83 diseases
briefs.summary: Capital Medical University researchers tracked 95,559 UK Biobank participants wearing wrist monitors for a median 8.9 years, reporting in PLOS Medicine. The observational study cannot show cause.

briefs.headline: Altman and Amodei ask UN Security Council for AI standards
briefs.summary: OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei told the council Wednesday that governments need shared capability tests and incident reporting; White House adviser Michael Kratsios rejected international oversight.

briefs.headline: Anthropic says Claude agents found a CRISPR-like enzyme system
briefs.summary: The company said 950 agents ran 21 hours to screen 200,000 bacteriophage genes down to 20 candidates; the result is a preprint, not peer reviewed. MIT's Feng Zhang called the fragments 'genuinely intriguing.'

briefs.headline: Gallup poll finds 68% of daily AI users in US worry about it
briefs.summary: The Microsoft-commissioned survey of about 1,000 people in each of 37 countries, taken April to July, found 74% of all Americans concerned and a 32% median worldwide; Singapore led daily use at 46%.

weather_ear: Thursday's forecast follows at 7:15, from the weather desk.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster ran no regional line; Xi is at the White House today, Hannan hosts Roane at Ashton at 6 p.m., and archery deer season opens Saturday.
